context: Daichi and Mei chat about family life.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (パパ/奥さん/鼻/駄目/言い方) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: うちの奥さん、料理が上手でな。
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty proud delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素敵ですね。パパとしても、幸せそう。
lines.en: Lovely. You seem happy as a dad too.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 子供が、よく鼻歌うたっとるわ。
lines.en: The kid often hums to themselves.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: かわいいですね。叱るのは駄目ですか?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: きつい言い方は、駄目やと思うとる。
lines.en: I think a harsh way of talking is no good.
lines.style: thoughtful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 言い方ひとつで、変わりますもんね。
lines.en: How you say it changes everything.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 奥さんが、優しい言い方を教えてくれたわ。
lines.en: My wife taught me the gentle way.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: bright woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
